Package models

Class Suite

java.lang.Object
models.Suite
public class Suite extends Object
Represents an individual bookable suite within a hotel in the MIRAGE system.

Each Suite belongs to exactly one Hotel and is assigned exactly one SuiteClass that determines its nightly rate and amenities. The suite number is a human-readable identifier unique within its hotel (e.g. "401-A").

When loaded via ReservationDAO.getAvailableSuites(), additional display fields (hotelName, nextAvailable) are populated for use in the UI suite grid.

Database mapping: suite table.

  • Constructor Details

    • Suite

      public Suite(int hotelId, int classId, String suiteNumber)
      Creates a new Suite with its core identity fields. suiteId is left at 0 until the record is persisted and the key is set via setSuiteId(int).
      Parameters:
      hotelId - the ID of the hotel this suite belongs to; must be positive
      classId - the ID of the suite class that defines its rate; must be positive
      suiteNumber - the human-readable suite number; must not be null or blank
